paragraphs.text: You lose your grip on reality.

If you have not yet suffered indefinite insanity, you now gain insane 
insight—add 5 points to your Cthulhu Mythos skill. If you have 
previously suffered indefinite insanity, add only 1 point.
Roll 1D6: if the result is 1–4, go to 550; if the result is 5–6, go to 549.
